name: 6g-nemotron-attestation-example
description: Reference example: a NIM-hosted Nemotron network-operations agent, governed by GRC_Claw's Agent Registry and Policy Firewall, with every decision signed post-quantum (ML-DSA-65 / FIPS 204). Complementary to NVIDIA NemoClaw/OpenShell's guardrail runtime, adds a quantum-safe attestation record.
